data.title: bn-3pt: Define RIBBIT RECOIL Apollo64 art bible and atlas budget

data.body: [high] Allocate enough authored pod geometry to cover the contact envelope, or change the interaction envelope with regressions. With the stated sockets, the pod-only pieces are a 24x24 core at `(-12,-23)` plus 16x16 head/panel modules centered at `(0,-39)` and `(0,-18)`: even if every pixel is opaque, they are at most 24px wide inside a 50px contact box and leave an eight-pixel vertical gap between the head and panel. The wing/weapon modules are explicitly behind/outside the closed pod and cannot make invisible pod contact readable. The same module set also cannot literally reach the weapon envelope top/bottom (`y=-52` / `y=+5`). Downstream bn-2v6 therefore cannot satisfy both “closed armor fills 50x52” and this allocation without inventing casing modules, retaining procedural fill, or changing collision. Make one of those choices explicit and update the allocation/sockets together.

[medium] Define the boss composition state table and every module socket. Origins `166/169` are only called “two core frames,” so their meanings are unknown; the proboscis/phase module at `164` has no center in the socket table; and there is no mapping from current `phase_id`, `vulnerable`, `hurt`, facing, and defeat states to core/head/panel/proboscis choices. bn-2v6 explicitly requires distinct phase, vulnerable/damaged, and defeat states. Name the two cores, give ID 164 a socket/facing rule, and state the runtime selection/composition rules so the asset/runtime worker does not design this state machine by guesswork.

[medium] Assign exact IDs to the prop block contents. The three 2x2 roots resolve to lamp/coil/crate, but the fourth 2x2 block leaves sign face, vent/barrel face, antenna, and cable footing ambiguous among IDs `230,231,246,247`. The VFX, terrain, actors, and overlays all have logical-to-physical mappings; downstream environment code needs the same deterministic mapping for metadata and placement rather than choosing an order independently.

[medium] Reconcile this production contract with dependent bone bn-3le before dispatch. The bone currently directs its worker to author both hop-compression and victory poses, while this bible forbids a compress frame and reuses `rise` plus an 8x8 victory overlay. Both cannot fit the declared ten-frame/six-overlay allocation. Update bn-3le (or explicitly revise this allocation) so the downstream worker has one authoritative deliverable list.

data.reason: Palette, terrain, platform behavior, current sockets, and the 256-cell atlas partition validate, but the boss module budget cannot cover its promised contact silhouette and leaves core/state/proboscis composition undefined. Prop IDs and bn-3le pose requirements also remain ambiguous for downstream execution.

data.body: Resolved. bn-3le now names exactly the ten full frames and six overlays in the bible, explicitly forbids unbudgeted compression/full-victory frames, and makes victory reuse rise plus overlay. The downstream acceptance criteria now match this allocation.
Fixed in ef520c2. Prop IDs are explicit: lamp 224/225/240/241, coil 226/227/242/243, crate 228/229/244/245, sign 230, vent/barrel 231, antenna 246, cable footing 247.

Fixed in ef520c2. IDs 166/169 are simultaneous upper/lower pod cores; module roles were revised to include left/right side armor and closed/open shutters. The new state table exhaustively maps dormant, phases 1-3, vulnerable, hurt, facing, and defeated composition, including scoped accent mapping and deterministic defeat disassembly. No unallocated proboscis remains.

Fixed in ef520c2 with an exact geometric construction. Upper/lower 24x24 cores plus 16x16 side armors have union bbox [-25,25)x[-50,2), exactly 50x52. Upper wings and claw/cannon extend the assembly to [-46,46)x[-52,6), exactly 92x58. I independently recomputed both bboxes; the doc requires opaque clusters to touch every edge and defines draw order/anchors.

data.reason: Fixed in ef520c2/cbef447 and independently recomputed: pod union bbox is exactly [-25,25)x[-50,2); phase 1/2/3 assembly bboxes are exactly [-46,46)x[-52,6), and all modules remain inside those bounds.

Fixed in ef520c2: both cores are simultaneous named assets; all ten modules have roles/sockets; dormant, phases, vulnerable, hurt, facing, and defeat composition are explicitly defined with scoped palette behavior.
Fixed in ef520c2: lamp, coil, crate, sign, vent/barrel, antenna, and cable footing now have exact physical IDs.
Fixed in the live bn-3le description: it now requires exactly the ten frames and six overlays, forbids unbudgeted compression/full-victory frames, and specifies rise plus overlay for victory.

Re-reviewed through cbef447. All four blockers are resolved: exact boss contact/weapon bboxes recompute to 50x52 and 92x58 in phases 1-3 with modules contained; boss asset roles, sockets, state composition, and scoped accents are explicit; prop cells have exact IDs; and bn-3le now matches the ten-frame/six-overlay contract. Apollo palette, terrain semantics, runtime coordinate derivations, and the overlap-free 256-cell atlas remain verified.
